title: Smith provider — provider.yaml
description: Top-level YAML for a Smith AI-provider folder under providers/<slug>/. Declares the provider's identity, the per-kind format files, discovery precedence, cross-kind interactions, and the decision matrix authors use to pick a kind.

slug.description: Provider slug. MUST equal the parent directory name.

docs.description: Map of named links to the provider's official documentation pages.

kinds.description: Per-kind index — MUST list agent, skill, hook (each with a matching format-*.yaml). May also list rules (no format file — minimal entry with consumer_path + invocation).

identity_rules.description: How identical slugs are resolved across scopes.

build.description: Configuration consumed by /smith-build — how to layout a release for this provider + how to map generic agent capabilities to native tool names. No business logic lives in the build script ; everything provider-specific is declared here.

consumer_paths.description: Consumer-side install path templates. Each value uses {slug} (skill / agent) or {bundle} (hook_dir) as the only placeholder.

settings.description: Consumer settings file for hook-fragment merges. null when the provider has no merge model.

emit_name.description: true → emit a `name:` field ; false → the filename carries the slug.

extra.description: Constant frontmatter keys to inject (e.g. `mode: subagent` for opencode).

tools_style.description: How the resolved tool allowlist is rendered into the agent frontmatter.

capability_map.description: Map of generic capability slug (read / glob / grep / bash / edit / write / skill / agent / ask-user / web-fetch) to the provider's native tool name. null when the capability has no equivalent on this provider — silently dropped from the resolved list.

skill_property_map.description: Map of generic bundle-skill property slug (model / user-invocable / ...) to the provider's native frontmatter key. null when the property has no equivalent on this provider — silently dropped from the rendered frontmatter. Values are passed through verbatim (no normalisation).

format.description: Relative path to the matching format-*.yaml file.

consumer_path.description: Where this kind lives in a consumer project.

invocation.description: How the user (or the AI) invokes this kind.

example.description: Relative path to the worked-out example under example/. Filename MUST start with example-<kind> and may carry a provider-specific suffix before the extension (e.g. example-agent.agent.md, example-hook-tasks.json).

kindEntryRules.description: Optional `rules` kind. Rules surfaces (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, ...) carry minimal or no frontmatter and do NOT get a dedicated format-*.yaml or worked-out example.

consumer_path.description: Where the rules artefact lives in a consumer project.

invocation.description: How rules are loaded (typically always-on or path-scoped).
